name: io.holokit.unity-sdk
description:
HoloKit turns an iPhone into an optical see-through stereo AR headset. The HoloKit Unity SDK builds on AR Foundation and adds:

- Stereoscopic rendering for the HoloKit headset, switchable with Mono (screen AR)
- Low-latency tracking: Kalman-filtered IMU prediction to the frame's display time
- Video recording with microphone and game audio
- Hand tracking and hand gesture recognition (Apple Vision and LiDAR)
- Gaze and gaze-gesture interaction

AR Foundation features such as plane detection and image tracking keep working in Stereo.

samples.description: Provides a demonstration of the SDK's stereoscopic rendering feature.
Checks world-locking against a real table: detected planes as a dot grid and rows of cubes standing on the table, with live prediction, display latency and frame-rate readouts.
Provides a demonstration of the SDK's hand tracking feature.
Pinch the thumb with any finger to place an object where they meet: a sphere for the index finger, a cube for the middle, a capsule for the ring and a cylinder for the little finger.
Provides a demonstration of the SDK's hand gesture recognition feature.
Provides a tool allowing developers to calibrate phones which are currently not supported by the SDK.
Provides a demonstration of using gaze to interact with UI elements in the scene.
Provides a demonstration of using gaze and hand gesture to interact with objects in the scene.
Provides a demonstration of using hand tracking and hand gesture recognition at the same time to spawn glowing orbs.
Provides a demonstration of resetting the AR session's world origin to a specific position and rotation.
Provides a demonstration of enabling ARKit's 4K and HDR options for the AR background video feed.
Demonstrates HoloKitVideoRecorder's two audio presets: raw environment microphone, and game audio plus echo-cancelled microphone on separate tracks.
A cat that turns to follow the viewer's head.
Logs whether the device has a LiDAR scanner.
